summary: trusted-review.yml ended in startup_failure on three pull request runs on 2026-11-16 between 17:24 and 17:37 UTC, with an unchanged workflow file
observed: Runs 43918035681, 43919940399, 43920222020: no job started and no check appeared on the pull request. It ran successfully on pull requests 6 to 9 before, and again on pull request 12 (run 43928758743, 18:26 UTC), with the same workflow file throughout. During the failures the default branch was at b7f2be6 and macOS runners were queueing for more than 15 minutes; GitHub reported no incident. Cause not determined: the reason is not exposed through the API. Left open for the maintainer to decide, since it stopped reproducing without a known fix.
